Land at PVG.notes: Land 13:00 · HO1148 from Guilin. Maglev from the terminal into town.

Shanghai Maglev.notes: PVG → Longyang Road at up to 430 km/h — the arrival-day tech experience.

Lunch.notes: Venue not chosen yet — open for shortlisted options.

Check in at Marriott.zh: 上海雅居乐万豪侯爵酒店
Check in at Marriott.notes: Four nights in central Puxi. Keep arrival light; leave ~17:30–18:00.

Nanjing Road East.notes: Walk from the Marriott down the pedestrian shopping street toward the river.

The Bund.notes: The first reveal of Pudong across the Huangpu.

Dinner.notes: Venue not chosen yet — open for shortlisted options.

Breakfast.notes: Hotel breakfast; open the hotel card for details.

Recovery massage / spa.notes: The recovery-day centrepiece after the Guilin transfer.

Jing’an Temple.notes: Golden-roofed temple amid the skyscrapers of Nanjing Road West.

Nanjing Road West.notes: Design, fashion and technology shops around Jing’an.

Dinner alt · Donghu Rd.notes: Alternative dinner strip in the Concession.

Wukang Building.notes: The flatiron 1924 apartment block — the icon of the French Concession.

Wukang Road.notes: Plane-tree-lined villas — walk it unhurried with coffee stops.

Ferguson Lane.notes: Leafy courtyard of cafes and boutiques off Wukang Road.

Anfu Road.notes: Buzzy cafe-and-boutique strip in the heart of the Concession.

Sinan Mansions.notes: Restored garden villas — dining and boutiques.

Fuxing Park.notes: French-designed park — locals dancing, chess and tai chi.

Old Jazz Bar.notes: The Fairmont Peace Hotel’s veteran jazz band — an old-Shanghai nightcap.

Dinner alt · Fumin Rd.notes: Alternative dinner strip in the Concession.

Yu Garden.notes: Classical Ming garden at opening — rockeries, ponds and pavilions.

Yuyuan Bazaar.notes: The old-city bazaar around the garden — snacks and souvenirs.

Mid-Lake Teahouse.notes: The zigzag-bridge teahouse on the lake — a Shanghai classic.

City God Temple.notes: Taoist temple at the heart of the old city.

People’s Square.notes: The civic heart — parks, museums and the metro hub. A heat-and-fatigue buffer.

M50 Creative Park.notes: Converted industrial buildings — galleries, studios and creek-side street art.

Huangpu night cruise.zh: 黄浦江夜游（十六铺码头）

West Bund riverside.notes: Riverside art district walk — museums, galleries and open space.

West Bund Museum.notes: Riverside modern-art museum — the West Bund art anchor.

Long Museum West Bund.notes: Striking concrete “vaulted” museum — major private collection.

TANK Shanghai.notes: Former aviation-fuel tanks turned galleries with a wrapping park.

Shanghai Tower base.notes: Ground-level walk around the 632 m tower.

Jin Mao Tower.notes: The pagoda-inspired supertall — outdoor Skywalk optional.

World Financial Center.notes: The “bottle-opener” — the third of the Lujiazui trio.

Shanghai Museum East.notes: ~3 focused h — bronzes, ceramics, jade and the key temporary show.

Pudong promenade.notes: Binjiang Avenue riverside walk beneath the Lujiazui towers.

Oriental Pearl Tower.notes: The 1994 space-age icon — exterior views from the promenade.

Fly from PVG.notes: HU7921 departs 02:10 the next morning — be here by 23:10 (3h, international).
